note: BH-8062: the weekly red-batch rate target. Once per ISO week the lane writes one ci-batch-red-week: line for the last complete Mon-Sun UTC week, with met=yes when that week's red merge-queue batches are at most this percent of its red plus green batches. 15 is the target in the BH-8062 ticket. A value outside 1..100 is the default. Settings key lane.ci-batch-red-report.ci_batch_red_target_pct.
